title: Plating
description: At the end of your turn, gain Block. Plating is reduced by 1 at the start of your turn.
smart_description: At the end of your turn, gain {Amount} Block. Plating is reduced by {Decrement} at the start of your turn.
notes: For enemies, the Decrement value scales with multiplayer player count. Enemies with Plating gain block at the start of combat (round 1 only). Block is gained during the early end-of-turn phase, before end-of-turn damage effects. Multiplayer: enemy block gain scales by ((players - 1) * 2 + 1) × Amount.
